_readme: myfriendroze overrides, deep-merged over .claude/hooks/config.json (kept identical to agents-master). See .claude/hooks/README.md, Project-local overrides.

custom_notes: Astro project root is astro/ — run build/dev/test commands from there
Firebase Functions live in firebase/functions/ — Node 22, CommonJS
Server-rendered: Astro SSR runs in the ssrAstro Cloud Function behind a Hosting rewrite
Merging to master auto-deploys Hosting + Functions; Firestore/Storage rules are always a manual deploy
Products and events are read live from Firestore per request; astro/src/data/events.js holds only hardcoded/recurring events

dep_guard.custom_message: Remember to commit package-lock.json changes alongside any dependency additions.
